description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Disputes between R. A. Amarasinghe and Lanka Sugar Complay (Pvt) Ltd.,
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - an order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint an arbitrator for an industrial dispute. It involves statutory powers, legal procedures, and regulatory action rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
